name: Figma MCP Server
description: Gives coding agents Figma design context, variables, screenshots, and generated code from frames, and lets them write frames and components back to the canvas via remote or desktop MCP.

skills.name: Get Design Context
skills.description: Returns a structured React and Tailwind representation of a Figma frame or layer that agents adapt to any framework.

skills.name: Extract Design Variables
skills.description: Pulls the color, spacing, and typography variables and styles used in a selection so generated code references tokens.

skills.name: Frame Screenshots
skills.description: Captures a screenshot of the selected node so agents can compare their implementation against the original design.

skills.name: Write to Canvas
skills.description: Creates and edits native Figma frames, components, variables, and auto layout from an MCP client (remote server only).
